key_highlights: ASX rose in early trade on Wall Street tech rally but treads water as RBA rate fears persist (Bullock hawkish stance)
Iron ore downside risk flagged; China rebalancing towards robots signals structural demand shift for BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX
Sydney housing market in 'bloodbath' mode; federal/state governments 'careen off debt cliff' raising fiscal sustainability concerns
Global diesel shortage (Iran/Ukraine) to last into 2027; Hormuz crisis pushing coal demand to record highs – bullish for energy names
Active ASX gold exploration: Broken Hill, Dalaroo, Platina, Forrestania, Great Southern all reporting positive results
Intergenerational Report locks in mass migration; Hastie open to baby bonus return – demographic/fiscal policy shift
Geopolitical risk elevated: Trump-Xi UN meeting, jet parts missing in HK, Trump 'drug boat' strikes under UN scrutiny

sectors.trend: Iron ore faces structural downside as China pivots to robotics; however, gold exploration activity is robust across WA, SA, and NSW. Diesel/coal supply disruption supports thermal coal names.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure from weaker iron ore. Gold juniors (BHG.AX, DLR.AX, PLT.AX, FRA.AX, GSO.AX) see positive catalysts. Coal names (BRL.AX, WDS.AX) benefit from Hormuz-driven demand.

sectors.trend: Hawkish RBA (Bullock) supports net interest margins but housing 'bloodbath' in Sydney raises credit risk. Fiscal debt cliff pressures government bond yields.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX benefit from higher-for-longer rates but face elevated NPL risk from property stress. Super Retail (SRE.AX) under ASIC investigation adds governance risk.

sectors.trend: Diesel shortage to 2027 and Hormuz crisis push coal/oil demand higher. Energy prices dumped on Democrat sweep hopes, creating volatility. LNG long-term agreements (Sempra 20-yr) signal structural demand.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, BRL.AX, SXG.AX, AWE.AX benefit from supply tightness. Volatility in oil prices creates trading opportunities but caps upside on policy shifts.

sectors.trend: ASX tech stocks rallied on Wall Street surge. Data centre buildout straining net-zero targets. CoreWeave, SPX Technologies, Forgent Power show AI infrastructure demand.
sectors.implications: ASX tech names (WES.AX, XRO.AX, SOL.AX) benefit from global tech momentum. Data centre power demand supports energy and infrastructure plays.

sectors.trend: Children's hospital funding gaps, aged care wage debts, and charity service cuts signal public health system strain. Consumer pressure from fuel costs.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX, WES.AX face mixed signals – public funding gaps may boost private providers. Consumer staples under pressure from diesel-driven cost inflation.

sectors.trend: Sydney housing 'bloodbath' and rental market disruption (agents being cut out) create structural headwinds. Higher rates suppress valuations.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX, ICV.AX) face yield compression and occupancy risk. Residential property developers under pressure.

key_themes: RBA hawkish pivot under Bullock – higher rates for longer
Iron ore structural demand shift as China rebalances to robotics
Global diesel/energy supply crisis (Hormuz, Iran, Ukraine) to 2027
Australian fiscal sustainability – debt cliff and intergenerational migration lock-in
Gold exploration super-cycle across ASX juniors
Geopolitical escalation: Trump-Xi tensions, UN security concerns
Sydney housing correction and rental market disruption
AI/data centre infrastructure driving tech and energy demand

risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge rate-sensitive sectors (REITs, property) with duration hedges; favour bank NIM beneficiaries

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Sydney housing market correction / credit stress
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to residential REITs and property developers; monitor bank NPL data

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Geopolitical escalation (Hormuz, Trump-Xi, HK jet parts)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain energy and gold hedges; diversify away from China-exposed supply chains
Rotate from pure iron ore exposure to diversified miners or gold/coal
Monitor government bond yields; favour inflation-linked and resource equities over rate-sensitive bonds
Overweight energy producers; monitor transport/logistics cost pass-through

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold exploration juniors on active drilling catalysts
opportunities.rationale: Multiple positive assay results (Broken Hill, Dalaroo, Platina, Great Southern) signal sector-wide upside; gold as geopolitical hedge

opportunities.recommendation: Add thermal coal and LNG exposure on supply disruption
opportunities.rationale: Hormuz crisis and diesel shortage to 2027 push coal demand to record; Sempra 20-yr LNG deal confirms structural demand

opportunities.recommendation: Favour large-cap banks on NIM expansion from hawkish RBA
opportunities.rationale: Bullock hawkish stance supports margins; offset housing risk with diversified loan books
ASX tech rally on Wall Street momentum; AI infrastructure demand supports power and cooling equities

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce residential REIT and property developer exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Sydney housing 'bloodbath', higher rates, and rental market disruption create downside risk
China robotics pivot and iron ore downside flag structural demand erosion for pure-play miners

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain gold and energy as geopolitical hedges
defensive_moves.rationale: Trump-Xi tensions, Hormuz crisis, and UN security concerns elevate tail risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Monitor fiscal policy risk; avoid long-duration government bonds
defensive_moves.rationale: Debt cliff and intergenerational migration lock-in threaten fiscal credibility

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound (5,200–5,500 ^AXJO) as tech rally offsets rate fears and housing stress. Gold juniors and energy names outperform. Volatility elevated on geopolitical headlines. AUD/USD pressured by hawkish RBA vs. global risk-off.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural headwinds from iron ore demand shift, fiscal debt accumulation, and housing correction cap index upside. Gold, energy, and healthcare offer relative strength. China's robotics pivot and global diesel crisis reshape commodity landscape through 2027.
